about: Dry chemical powder (DCP) extinguishers typically use a bicarbonate-based powder to smother Class B (flammable liquid) and Class C (gas) fires. They suit petrol pumps, workshops, generator rooms and industrial sites and give fast knockdown of flammable-liquid fires.
DCP is not effective on Class A fires such as wood and paper, and it leaves a residue. Inspect regularly and refill after every use, even a short discharge.
